Run a configurable curation Shiny application.

Source: R/curation_app.R
run_curation.Rd

Run a configurable curation Shiny application.

Usage

run_curation(
  config,
  records_provider,
  review_repository,
  artifact_store,
  actor_resolver,
  request = NULL,
  launch.browser = interactive(),
  actor_probe = NULL,
  logout_path = NULL,
  historical_reviews = NULL,
  input_provenance = NULL,
  cohort_receipt = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

config

A planscanR_curation_config.

records_provider

A planscanR_curation_records_provider.

review_repository

A planscanR_curation_review_repository.

artifact_store

A planscanR_curation_artifact_store used for sample, snapshot, and model seams.

actor_resolver

A trusted planscanR_curation_actor_resolver.

request

Optional deployment request value or function accepting session; it is passed to the actor resolver.

launch.browser

Passed to shiny::runApp().

actor_probe

Optional non-touching actor resolver used by the periodic socket-expiry check. Mutation paths always use actor_resolver.

logout_path

Optional local POST path rendered as a visible Log out control, for example /app/logout. It is absent by default.

historical_reviews

Optional data frame of imported historical review linkage and attribution rows. Unresolved rows are shown read-only.

input_provenance

Optional BIOGAIN or caller-supplied identity for the compatible scored input. The app adds the loaded snapshot identity and content fingerprint before training.

cohort_receipt

Optional immutable historical-cohort receipt carried into the model and publication provenance.

...

Further arguments passed to shiny::runApp(), such as host or port.

Value

Invisibly, the result of shiny::runApp().
